_comment: §4 Teams telephony control map (Vol IX Book 04). Governed telephony catalog + Teams SCuBA drift. Number/calling-policy/voice-routing changes are change-controlled with E911 validation; Teams SCuBA drift folds into the Vol VII Book 02 M365 loop. Actuation via Graph/Teams admin through the in-boundary MID. Projection of orgcomp-compliance-spine.yml, CI-validated against it (slots, KSI themes, boundary, schema) by validate_day2_control_maps.py. Scope: FedRAMP Moderate + GCC Moderate.

tel.number.assign.title: Assign / release phone number
tel.number.assign.note: Reconciled to the number inventory; release returns the number to the pool.

tel.callingpolicy.assign.title: Assign calling policy / dial plan
tel.callingpolicy.assign.note: Least-privilege calling scope (e.g. domestic-only by default).

tel.e911.validate.title: Emergency address (E911) validation
tel.e911.validate.note: Validated on assignment — a mis-mapped emergency address is a life-safety defect; a gate, not a form field.

tel.scuba.drift.title: Teams SCuBA baseline drift
tel.scuba.drift.note: Extends the Vol VII Book 02 M365 loop to the Teams surface (CISA SCuBA / BOD 25-01).

tel.audit.collect.title: Collect call-detail and telephony admin-action telemetry
tel.audit.collect.note: Call-detail records and telephony administrative actions (number assignment, policy change, voice-routing change) routed into the evidence contract at onboarding. The spine closed AU-2 for this lane from the start; this item is what actually carries it — added 2026-07-14 when the projection gate surfaced the closure as bound to no catalog item.
